title: Winey Pastry Flan
description: A rich and creamy keto dessert with a hint of wine and a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry sheet to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Transfer it to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the winey pastry cream, eggs, granulated sweetener, and melted butter until smooth.
Pour the cream mixture into the pastry-lined tart pan and smooth the top.
Dot the top with the heavy cream and sprinkle with vanilla extract.
Bake the flan for 35-40 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Chill the flan in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Serve the winey pastry flan chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of granulated sweetener and a drizzle of heavy cream if desired.
